newsitem.title: USA: PhyCor Inc raises $183.8 mln in IPO.
newsitem.headline: PhyCor Inc raises $183.8 mln in IPO.

text.p: PhyCor Inc said Thursdy it completed its initial public offering of 6,400,000 shares of PhyCor Common Stock at $30.00 per share. The net proceeds to PhyCor from the offering of about $183.8 million will be used to repay bank debt.
The offering was managed by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc; Equitable Securities Corp; Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc; Piper Jaffray Inc.; and Salomon Brothers Inc.
If the underwriters' over-allotment option is exercised, PhyCor may sell up to an additional 895,000 shares of Common Stock, and 65,000 shares may be sold by certain selling shareholders.
PhyCor is a physician practice management company that operates multi-specialty clinics and manages independent practice associations.
